messages:
Emma: Quick sync — landing page for Benchmark Launch (next Tue). Need a short SEO playbook: target keywords per page, JSON-LD schema, internal linking plan, redirects from beta/legacy URLs, and webinar UTM/tracking. Who can own redirects?
Luis: I can own redirects + keyword mapping. Please drop a list of old URLs and target slugs.
Maya: I’ll take meta titles/descriptions and schema. Suggest we pick 2–3 target keywords per page: 'low-latency inference', 'inference cost optimization', 'Redwood inference platform' as starters.
Chris: Webinar landing needs UTM defaults and a clean CTA. Also want a fallback redirect from /events/bench-2025 -> /webinars/bench-launch.
Oliver: I’ll do the actual redirect rules and deploy. Example nginx snippet for event redirect:```rewrite ^/events/bench-2025$ /webinars/bench-launch?utm_source=newsletter permanent;``` Also remember canonical tags on the landing.
Luis: For schema: Event + Organization + BreadcrumbList. Draft JSON-LD (will refine):```{ "@context":"https://schema.org", "@type":"Event", "name":"Redwood Benchmark Launch", "startDate":"2026-04-05T16:00:00Z", "location":{ "@type":"VirtualLocation", "url":"https://redwood.com/webinars/bench-launch" } }```
Maya: I’ll paste the ld+json in the head and ensure the visible event markup matches. Will also add internal links from /docs/perf-tuning and /pricing/dedicated.
Zoe: I’ll add GA4 conversion and server-side logging to validate redirects. Suggest we standardize UTM params: utm_source=org-mail, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=bench-launch-2026. I’ll add mapping in the analytics property.
Emma: Owner map for clarity: Luis = redirects + keywords; Maya = meta + schema; Oliver = deploy redirects; Zoe = tracking; Chris = webinar copy + CTAs. Can we aim for PRs by Friday EOD?
Oliver: Yes — I’ll open a draft PR today and include the redirect file. Tagging @Luis @Maya for review.
Luis: Sample redirects file I'll commit to repo:```# redirects.txt
/old-benchmarks -> /benchmarks/2026 301
/beta/bench -> /benchmarks/2026 301
/old-whitepaper -> /resources/redwood-inference-whitepaper-2026 301
/events/bench-2025 -> /webinars/bench-launch 301```
Maya: :thumbsup: Will push meta updates and schema snippet. Quick note — confirm no hreflang needed for this launch.
Chris: Also request: add a single-click canonical fallback for legacy subdomain traffic. Some customers still hit legacy.redwood.com.
Oliver: Will add wildcard redirect for legacy subdomain in server config:```server_name ~^legacy\\..*; return 301 https://redwood.com$request_uri;``` 
Emma: Great — lets run a quick redirect smoke test after deploy and check tracking. Friday 10am sync to verify. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
